code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            v = grid[0][c]
            candidates.append((sum(row.count(v) for row in grid), "v", c))
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            v = grid[r][0]
            candidates.append((sum(row.count(v) for row in grid), "h", r))
    _, axis, sep = min(candidates)
    if axis == "v":
        n = min(sep, w - sep - 1)
        first = [row[sep-n:sep] for row in grid]
        second = [row[sep+1:sep+1+n] for row in grid]
    else:
        n = min(sep, h - sep - 1)
        first = grid[sep-n:sep]
        second = grid[sep+1:sep+1+n]
    count1 = Counter(v for row in first for v in row)
    count2 = Counter(v for row in second for v in row)
    bg1 = count1.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg2 = count2.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg1 = min((num, v) for v, num in count1.items() if v != bg1)[1]
    out = [[fg1 for _ in row] for row in first]
    for r in range(len(first)):
        for c in range(len(first[0])):
            a, b = first[r][c], second[r][c]
            if a == b and (a != bg1 or b != bg2):
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
